title: Spectral Ruleset
description: Schema for a Spectral API governance ruleset file (.spectral.yml or .spectral.json). Defines rules for linting OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, and other API description formats.

oneOf.description: Extend a single ruleset by name or file path (e.g. 'spectral:oas')

rules.description: Custom rules or overrides for extended rules

formats.description: Format hints to restrict which documents this ruleset applies to

functionsDir.description: Path to directory containing custom rule functions

functions.description: List of custom function names to load

description.description: Human-readable description of what this rule checks

message.description: Error message to display when the rule fails. Use {{value}} and {{path}} as placeholders.

oneOf.description: JSONPath expression targeting nodes to evaluate

given.description: JSONPath expression(s) selecting nodes to apply the rule to

formats.description: Restrict this rule to specific formats

resolved.description: Whether to run on resolved ($ref dereferenced) or raw document

recommended.description: Whether this rule is included in 'recommended' severity mode

RuleCheck.description: A single assertion in a Spectral rule

field.description: Field path within the target node to apply the function to

function.description: Name of the assertion function (e.g. truthy, defined, pattern, schema, enumeration)

functionOptions.description: Options passed to the assertion function

notMatch.description: Regex to not match for pattern function
